Det finns släktingar till vår modell som: There are relatives of our model that are built for other tasks. These are the most common ones.
<b>Decoder-only</b> (GPT, Llama): causal: Decoder-only (GPT, Llama): causal mask, generates text. The focus of this course.
<b>Encoder-only</b> (BERT): varje token: Encoder-only (BERT): every token sees all the others. Produces good vectors for classification and embeddings, but does not generate.
<b>Encoder-decoder</b> (T5, Whisper): en: Encoder-decoder (T5, Whisper): an encoder reads the input, a decoder generates and reads the encoder via cross-attention.
<b>SSM och hybrider</b> (Mamba, Jamba):: SSM and hybrids (Mamba, Jamba): a fixed-size state replaces the growing KV cache. Linear time in sequence length. Hybrids mix in a few attention layers so they do not lose precision.
Fyra attention-mönster: causal, bidirekt: Four attention patterns: causal, bidirectional, encoder-decoder and SSM
MHA: one KV head per query head. Largest cache.
<b>GQA</b>: grupper av query heads delar: GQA: groups of query heads share KV (Llama 3, Mistral, Qwen).
MQA: a single KV head for all of them.
<b>MLA</b> (DeepSeek-V2/V3): K och V kom: MLA (DeepSeek-V2/V3): K and V are compressed into a latent vector that gets cached, and unpacked when needed.
<b>Sliding window</b>: vissa lager ser b: Sliding window: some layers only see the most recent W tokens, so their cache stops growing. Gemma 2 and 3 alternate local layers with global ones.
Det finns flera sätt att bygga attention: There are several ways to build attention that save memory. The difference shows above all in how large the cache gets.

Alla experter måste ligga i minnet, även: All experts have to sit in memory, even though only a few are used at a time. That brings particular challenges when you run the model.
<b>Små batchar:</b> varje token läser ba: Small batches: each token reads only its own experts’ weights. Decode gets fast, almost like a model the size of the active parameters.
<b>Stora batchar:</b> olika tokens välje: Large batches: different tokens pick different experts, and soon all of them are in use. Then all the weights get read again, and the advantage lies in the compute, not the memory.
<b>Expert parallelism:</b> experterna fö: Expert parallelism: the experts are spread across GPUs. Each token is sent to the right GPU (all-to-all dispatch) and the results are sent back (combine). That is a lot of communication, so fast links between the GPUs matter.
<b>Obalans:</b> om många tokens väljer s: Imbalance: if many tokens pick the same expert, one GPU becomes the bottleneck while the others wait.

Bilder kan göras om till samma sorts vek: Images can be turned into the same kind of vectors as words. Then the model reads them as if they were text.
En bild delas i rutor (patches), körs ge: An image is split into patches, run through a vision encoder (usually a ViT) and projected to the same width d as the language model’s residual stream. The result is inserted into the sequence where a placeholder token stood.
Därefter är bildtokens vanliga positione: After that, image tokens are ordinary positions in the stream: they get K and V in the cache and can be attended to like any word.
Exempel: LLaVA-1.5 delar en bild på 336: Example: LLaVA-1.5 splits a 336 × 336 pixel image into 14 × 14 patches, which gives 576 image tokens. So images are expensive in both prefill and KV memory.
vLLM kör encodern separat och cachar des: vLLM runs the encoder separately and caches its output so the same image is not encoded twice.

I stället för en stor MLP kan en våning: Instead of one large MLP, a floor can hold many small ones and a switch that picks a few of them for each word. The model gets bigger but not slower per word.
I en MoE-modell ersätts MLP:n i varje la: In an MoE model, the MLP in each layer is replaced by many smaller MLPs (experts) and a router. Attention is still dense.
Each token is sent to top-k experts. So the model carries a lot of knowledge (many parameters) at a low cost per token (few active).
<b>Minnet</b> bestäms av totalen: alla e: Memory is set by the total: all experts must sit in GPU memory. The compute per token is set by the active ones.
